Subject: Post-call recap + trial ops: QuantForge POC plan & credentialing

Hi Sandeep / Priya (looping you in),

Great to meet your team today — thanks for walking through the primary jobs-to-be-done and the three quick experiments you want to run (intent classification, reranking, prompt enrichment). Per our call I captured the minimal trial plan so we can get you to a meaningful pass/fail within two weeks. Please review and confirm owners/dates below.

Success criteria (proposed):
- Intent classifier reaches >= 88% macro-F1 on your evaluation set (owner: QuantForge)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation < 220ms for the 512-token config (owner: Redwood Infra)
- Cost per 1k tokens at or below the threshold in the pricing outline (owner: Finance/Sales)

Trial milestones & owners:
1) Access & creds (by Tue Apr 13) — Redwood provides SSO invitations (Okta), an ephemeral API key for the quick dev loop, and an IP allowlist stub. (owner: Ben Carter)
2) Dataset ingest & runbook (by Thu Apr 15) — QuantForge shares the evaluation dataset and the label schema; Redwood shares the eval harness. (owner: Sandeep / Priya)
3) Canary runs & monitoring (Apr 18–20) — run initial tests, collect latency/cost metrics, and validate outputs against gold labels. (owner: Laura for run coordination)

Attachments: poc-success-criteria-template.xlsx (fillable), and I'll upload the shared Drive folder with the runbook after access is accepted.

Open question you raised about SSO vs IP allowlist for day-1: Ben will propose a short-term hybrid (SSO + temp key) so you can start immediately while your Okta team completes SCIM mapping.

Next steps for your team: confirm the evaluation dataset location and who should receive the SSO invite (list names + Okta org) by end of day Apr 15.

If that timeline works, Ben will create the ephemeral API key and drop the allowlist ranges so your infra can add them.

Thanks — I will follow up with a calendar invite for the Apr 18 canary window after we confirm access.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(attachment: poc-success-criteria-template.xlsx)
